acceptance_met: All eight section-4 producer cells (nb-produce-bulk, nb-produce-idem, nb-produce-mixed-topics, nb-produce-headers, nb-produce-128p, nb-produce-flush-heavy, nb-send-seq, nb-produce-idle-rss) are implemented exactly as defined in performance-leadership.md section 4 with the documented defaults (cells.rs; tests pin IDs, record totals, modes, idempotence and round-robin layout).

Allocation counting reuses the KL09-04 tool (codec::census over codec::CountingAlloc); CPU time and RSS come from libc getrusage/task_info inside the harness crate via measure.rs; the core crate is untouched (workspace-excluded crate, no partitionline edits).

Every run emits a result artifact with provenance, cell ID and repetition index; disposition is failed on any server-side validation failure, unacknowledged record or timeout (artifact.rs; broker counts reconciled from the nb-serve artifact, child rusage via wait4).
commands: cargo test --locked --manifest-path benchmarks/runtime/Cargo.toml (10 passed: 5 cells + 4 host_measure + 1 e2e, exit 0)
cargo clippy --manifest-path benchmarks/runtime/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings (0 warnings, exit 0)
python3 scripts/benchmark-report.py <each of the 8 artifacts> --quiet --json (8/8 valid, 0 errors)
limits: Null-broker (loopback) tier only: numbers measure client-side headroom, never feed claims (Suite HOLD active; cells registered exploratory/feeds_claims=false).
Records are pregenerated before the measured phase; generation CPU/allocs are outside the census but the fixture lives in RSS during the run (baseline_rss_bytes reported for subtraction).
RSS peak/mean come from a 10ms sampler; sub-10ms spikes can be missed (ru_maxrss reported separately as the process-wide reference).
macOS reports frequency_mhz 0.0 (no sysctl source on Apple Silicon; documented gap) and thread_count 0 (Linux-only /proc read).
Latency is per-record send-call time; flush-heavy flush time is reported separately in flush_us_total.

measurements.host: darwin arm64, release build, loopback nb-serve, 1 repetition per cell
